selection_rationale: M909 proves the explicit double-exponential barrier B_n>=2^(2+2^(n-2)) despite the exact tax. M908 compares this with q_j<2^(j+6) and composes it with the audited first-wall theorem, giving recovery by p(j)=2+ceil(log2(j+4)). M912 remains frozen because no all-orbit or suffix theorem is available.
